sources.title: Standard Geographical Classification (SGC) 2021 - Classification structure
sources.refreshPolicy: new SGC release plus official interim municipal changes
sources.notes: Provides the national geography spine. It does not by itself prove that every CSD has a governing body.

plannedSources.title: Census Subdivision Boundary File, 2025
plannedSources.transport: GPKG, SHP, GML, GDB, Esri REST, or WMS
plannedSources.notes: Current intercensal CSD layer. It must be added before current legal-geography coverage can be complete.

plannedSources.title: First Nations Location
plannedSources.transport: CSV, GPKG, SHP, FGDB, WFS, WMS, or Esri REST
plannedSources.notes: National First Nations anchor. Reserve geography and First Nation government identity must remain separate.

plannedSources.title: Municipal Directory
plannedSources.notes: Reconcile towns, cities, Inuit Community Governments, local service districts, and regional service boards as distinct body types.

plannedSources.title: GeoAtlas Municipal Boundaries
plannedSources.notes: Current boundary service; gazetted descriptions remain legally authoritative and asset-specific reuse must be confirmed.

plannedSources.title: Municipal and Provincial Affairs Agencies
plannedSources.notes: Regional service-board coverage and current counts require direct departmental reconciliation.

plannedSources.title: PEI Municipalities and Municipal Directory
plannedSources.notes: Confirm whether the PEI Open Government Licence covers each selected service before redistribution.

plannedSources.title: Municipal Zones Feature Service
plannedSources.transport: ArcGIS REST JSON or GeoJSON; service metadata says nightly updates
plannedSources.notes: The service has no asset-level licence field; obtain confirmation before redistributing its geometry.

plannedSources.title: Municipality Boundaries
plannedSources.transport: Socrata CSV, JSON, GeoJSON, OData, SHP, or GDB
plannedSources.notes: Incorporated villages require the separate official village-boundaries dataset. Treat this as cartographic/crosswalk evidence until a complete legal roster or authority source is separately reviewed.

plannedSources.title: Village Boundaries
plannedSources.transport: Socrata CSV, JSON, GeoJSON, OData, SHP, or GDB
plannedSources.notes: Quarterly official village layer based on civic-address community boundaries. The publisher says these are not legal boundaries and are for cartographic use only; civic communities remain address geographies rather than governing bodies.

plannedSources.title: GeoNB Local Governance
plannedSources.transport: ArcGIS REST JSON, GeoJSON, PBF, FGDB, KML, or SHP
plannedSources.notes: Local governments, rural districts, and regional service commissions are separate entity classes. The province states that regional service commissions are shared-service organizations, not a level of government, so they must not be emitted as regional governments.

plannedSources.publisher: Ministère des Affaires municipales et de l'Habitation
plannedSources.title: Répertoire des municipalités du Québec
plannedSources.notes: Preserve provincial geographic codes, MRCs, boroughs, metropolitan bodies, history, and relationships.

plannedSources.publisher: Ministère des Ressources naturelles et des Forêts
plannedSources.title: Découpages administratifs
plannedSources.transport: SHP, GPKG, FGDB, WMS, or ArcGIS REST; monthly when changed
plannedSources.notes: Use the published provincial geographic code for exact joins; mapped boundaries are not legal instruments.

plannedSources.publisher: Institut de la statistique du Québec
plannedSources.title: Fichiers du code géographique du Québec
plannedSources.transport: Monthly XML or text plus historical files
plannedSources.notes: Provides official code history needed to reconcile mergers, dissolutions, and name changes.

plannedSources.title: Ontario Municipalities
plannedSources.notes: Combine the official roster with LIO identifiers; northern districts are geography, not municipal governments.

plannedSources.title: Municipal Boundaries - Lower, Single, Upper Tier and District
plannedSources.transport: CKAN download plus LIO ArcGIS REST JSON, GeoJSON, or PBF
plannedSources.notes: Use official identifiers and tier fields; territorial districts are not automatically regional governments.

plannedSources.title: Municipal Officials Directory
plannedSources.notes: Exclude personal official contact details; separately model planning, watershed, assessment, and northern bodies.

plannedSources.title: Incorporated Municipal Boundaries
plannedSources.notes: The service does not state an asset-level licence; verify redistribution terms before publication.

plannedSources.title: Northern Affairs Communities
plannedSources.notes: Separate coverage is required because Northern Affairs communities are absent from the incorporated-municipality roster.

plannedSources.title: Municipal Directory
plannedSources.notes: Use Statistics Canada for the redistributable core until bulk-directory reuse permission is confirmed.

plannedSources.title: Urban, Rural and Northern Municipal Boundary Services
plannedSources.transport: ArcGIS REST JSON, GeoJSON, or PBF
plannedSources.notes: The service metadata restricts redistribution. Obtain written permission or use a separately licensed boundary source.

plannedSources.title: Municipal Locations and Codes
plannedSources.transport: Municipal code/history files and profile downloads
plannedSources.notes: Preserve hamlets, special areas, improvement districts, Métis Settlements, and regional service commissions as distinct classes.

plannedSources.title: Alberta Municipal Officials Directory
plannedSources.notes: Covers municipalities, special areas, Métis settlements, regional services commissions, and associations; omit personal contact fields.

plannedSources.title: Municipal Boundary Public Service
plannedSources.transport: ArcGIS REST JSON, GeoJSON, or PBF
plannedSources.notes: Use governing rural and specialized boundary classes; hamlets and localities are subordinate geographies.

plannedSources.title: Services Commissions and Their Municipalities
plannedSources.notes: Provides membership needed to model regional shared-service relationships without name inference.

plannedSources.title: Municipalities - Legally Defined Administrative Areas
plannedSources.transport: BCGW download, WMS, KML, or ArcGIS REST JSON, GeoJSON, or PBF
plannedSources.notes: Regional districts use a separate official layer. Reconcile legal names, tiers, and effective boundaries to current letters patent/orders in council before publication.

plannedSources.title: Regional Districts - Legally Defined Administrative Areas
plannedSources.transport: BCGW download, WMS, KML, or ArcGIS REST JSON, GeoJSON, or PBF
plannedSources.notes: Regional districts are separate governing bodies; electoral areas remain governed geographies. Current letters patent/orders in council prevail for incorporation, name, membership, and effective boundary changes.

plannedSources.title: Local Government Directory
plannedSources.notes: Municipalities, local advisory councils, and Indigenous governments remain separate entity types.

plannedSources.title: Municipal Boundaries
plannedSources.transport: CKAN API, ArcGIS Online, SHP, or FGDB
plannedSources.notes: Ad-hoc official boundary updates; municipal governments remain distinct from local advisory councils and First Nations.

plannedSources.title: MACA Communities
plannedSources.notes: Preserve the distinction between municipalities and designated authorities; omit personal contact fields.

plannedSources.title: Current Hamlets Act and continuation orders
plannedSources.notes: Use Statistics Canada as the machine-readable base and obtain reuse approval before redistributing a bulk legal roster.

plannedSources.title: Current Cities, Towns and Villages Act and Iqaluit orders
plannedSources.notes: Required for the City of Iqaluit, including its continuation and status-change orders. Consolidations may be unofficial or not current, so original enactments and amendments prevail where the publisher warns of a conflict.
